reviewed_by: Codex focused review of native completion-hook feedback
reason: A blocking native completion hook now supplies bounded feedback to one model correction attempt across provider chat paths. The selected cases cover feedback delivery, revised-answer recheck, tool-enabled rerouting, persistent rejection, and held streaming output.
exclusions: No frontend, native, or Playwright tests are selected because this diff changes only provider-turn orchestration and its Python regression tests. No full suites or live provider calls. Production UI, LAN, and physical-device journeys remain unverified.
